goal: See what one step of gradient descent does to a guess.
audience: a learner who knows what a slope is

scenes.learningPoint: A step moves the guess downhill, against the slope.
scenes.visualIntent: A parabola, a dot at x = 3, an arrow to x = 1.8.
scenes.narrationSummary: The slope at 3 is 6; a step of 0.2 times 6 moves the guess to 1.8.
